title: Candidate Screening
summary: Screen hundreds of resumes in minutes, not days, with explainable AI scoring.
headline: Screen hundreds of resumes *in minutes, not days*
lede: TalentPool365 reads every resume, pulls out the skills that matter, and scores each candidate against your job requirements. Your recruiters get a ranked shortlist instead of a pile of applications.
sectionIntro: TalentPool365 reads every resume, pulls out the skills that matter, and scores each candidate against your job requirements. Your recruiters get a ranked shortlist instead of a pile of applications.

capabilities.title: Resume Parsing
capabilities.tagline: Turn every resume into clean, searchable data.
capabilities.body: Resumes arrive in every format and layout. Our AI reads them all and converts them into structured candidate profiles, so nobody has to retype details by hand.
points: Supports PDF, Word and other common formats
Extracts contact details, work history, education and certifications
Handles different layouts, including multi-column resumes
Duplicate profiles are flagged automatically

capabilities.title: Skill Extraction
capabilities.tagline: See the skills behind the job titles.
capabilities.body: A job title doesn’t tell you what someone can actually do. Our AI identifies hard skills, soft skills, tools and domain expertise from the full resume, including skills that aren’t listed in a skills section.
points: Detects skills from projects, roles and achievements
Recognizes related skills and alternate names, e.g. 'JS' and 'JavaScript'
Estimates experience level for each skill
Builds a skill profile for every candidate

capabilities.title: AI Candidate Matching
capabilities.tagline: Match on meaning, not just keywords.
capabilities.body: Our AI compares each candidate’s skills, experience and background with your job description. It understands context, so strong candidates aren’t missed because their resume uses different wording.
points: Semantic matching between resumes and job requirements
Separate weighting for must-have and nice-to-have skills
A clear match score for every candidate
Fewer false rejections and fewer irrelevant applicants

capabilities.title: Candidate Ranking
capabilities.body: Every applicant is scored and ranked automatically, so your team starts with the strongest fits. You can see why a candidate ranked where they did.
points: Ranked lists for every open role
Transparent score breakdown by skills, experience and education
Adjustable criteria to match your hiring priorities
Rankings that improve as you give feedback on candidates

capabilities.title: Smart Shortlisting
capabilities.body: Create a shortlist in one click. Set your criteria, and TalentPool365 selects the top candidates and prepares them for the next stage, whether that is assessment or interview.
points: Automatic shortlists based on your match thresholds
Side-by-side candidate comparison
Shortlists shared with hiring managers for quick approval
Smooth hand-off to assessments and interviews

outcomes.label: drop in manual resume screening hours
faster time to produce approved shortlists
black-box scores: every rank is explainable

closingCta.headline: Hire on merit, at speed.
closingCta.body: See how TalentPool365 screens candidates faster, with less manual work.
